title: The review-record form has one slot per round 1 to 4 and one grant line; PR 3288 needs a fifth read and two grant lines
why: PR #3288 got a fifth read after grant 789 a and the form cannot take it.
source: Lane gh-quota-budget 20:06 CST Nov 13, from runner 10's read of merge --help at 20:05 and the lane's refused run with a fifth round; triage read neither. Past rulings: the cap is three rounds, round 4 by grant (decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3, pr-review-record); triage did not read the record-form text.
note: Filed 20:07 CST Nov 13. Fact (lane): merge --review-record --grant takes one grant value and needs rounds 1..4, so #3288 cannot record the fresh read after grant 789 a or hold both grant lines. Interim pick by triage (undoable, no owner word): option B, the lane records the fifth read in a PR comment and reports whether the merge check accepts it; undo: delete the comment. Option A (a form change taking more reads and grant lines) is a build lane on a check, left unstarted until the coordinator says it is wanted beyond this one PR; the form limit may be by design (round cap three, round 4 by grant). Unchecked: whether the merge check reads a comment as the record.
